### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**14** anchor(s) derived from **2** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them. ⚠️ **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/services/service-automation/README.md`, `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`, `packages/spec/src/automation/flow-text-slot-template.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/services/service-automation/README.md`, `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`, `packages/spec/src/automation/flow-text-slot-template.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **8** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **139** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c63028e5bfb63aba438ed8de9febad86f448de91` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `ca1a38860f28efd6cb155af1a64a2ff862c2610c` — the merge of head `9387cf70ceb6106bb7087cbc5ffd25e6af09bc48` into base `c63028e5bfb63aba438ed8de9febad86f448de91`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin ca1a38860f28efd6cb155af1a64a2ff862c2610c && git checkout ca1a38860f28efd6cb155af1a64a2ff862c2610c
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin c63028e5bfb63aba438ed8de9febad86f448de91 9387cf70ceb6106bb7087cbc5ffd25e6af09bc48 && git checkout -B drift-repro c63028e5bfb63aba438ed8de9febad86f448de91 && git merge --no-ff 9387cf70ceb6106bb7087cbc5ffd25e6af09bc48

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c63028e5bfb63aba438ed8de9febad86f448de91
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `9387cf70ceb6106bb7087cbc5ffd25e6af09bc48`
Local-runs: none

Read: card #19939 body and all 34 comments (stage plan `6096263424`, census `6096228459`, claim `6096277270`, S1 report `6100937127`); PR #22715 body, its 38 files, and `git diff origin/main...9387cf70ce` (merge-base `d8830c2805`, +1099/−160, 38 files — equal to the PR file list); the head's check-runs (two polls); ruling D on #11182 (`5805777944`); ADR-0032 Decisions 2 and 3; ADR-0087 D2, D3 and the pre-GA level bullet; `.changeset/pre.json` on `main`; `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`, the WHICH-LEVEL prose in `pr-automation.yml`; the three earlier `19939-*.md` changesets on `main`.

**Check-runs at write time (second poll):** 21 completed — every one `success` except `Console Pin Gate` and `Packed-tarball smoke` (`skipped`); 11 `in_progress`: `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Test Core` 1–6, `Dogfood Regression Gate` 1/3 and 3/3, `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)`, `Type Check · workspace`. Green among the required set: `Build Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`; `Type Check · source gates` (the spec generated-artifact gates: spec-changes, upgrade-guide, authorable-surface, docs) and `· consumer gates`, `· debt ledger` are green; `Check Changeset` green. The verdict below is on the diff and the contract; enqueue still waits on the pending required contexts (an `in_progress` is not a pass).

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set, the three positions.** `SubflowConfigSchema.input`, `MapConfigSchema.input`, `ScriptConfigSchema.inputs` go from a record of `z.unknown()` to a record of `FlowValueSlotSchema`: a single-brace token refused at `registerFlow`, `objectstack validate` and the executor's `parseNodeConfig`; a CEL envelope and every literal accepted exactly as before. Nothing newly accepted — a narrowing only. RIGHT (ADR-0032 D2: a computed value is whole-field CEL; D3: single brace deleted; ruling D's C half).
- **Ledger.** `FLOW_NODE_EXPRESSION_PATHS` appends three `value` rows (`subflow input.*`, `map input.*`, `script inputs.*`); the one judge walks the ledger, so no second judge at any door. `map.collection` keeps its `flow-template` row on the descriptor channel; the channel split is pinned (`config-expression-ledger.test.ts`: descriptors for `map` = `collection` only, schemaless = `input.*` only). RIGHT.
- **`LEDGER_DECLARED_NODE_CONFIG_SCHEMAS` + `map` (the dev's flag).** Measured at the head: `LedgerDeclaredNodeType` is read only inside spec (the entries cast and the return type of `getSchemalessNodeConfigJsonSchemas()`, whose returned record now carries a `map` key); no published function takes it as an input; `api-surface/automation.json` and `export-origins/` do not move. Under the repo's definition (WHICH-LEVEL: "a new exported symbol on an index, a new accepted key or value"; the `Clause-②` question 「本卡放宽接受集或扩大公开面吗」) this is data in an existing export on the output side — not a new accepted key or value on a published payload. It does not flip the line to `yes`. RIGHT.
- **`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`** — right for every part: the accept set narrows (the arm), nothing widens (the value). Consistent with passes 2 and 3 (`no (narrowing)`, no snapshot moved); pass 1 read `yes (narrowing)` only because it added the judge's exports, which this PR does not. RIGHT.
- **The callee sentence.** `CALLEE_INPUT_SLOTS` is keyed by the ledger entry and reaches the two build doors and the lint hints through `flowNodeValueTemplateRefusals`; the executor parse judges a value with no position and carries the base remedy alone — the boundary is pinned (`callee-input-value-slots.test.ts` §1). A second table keyed by entry string is drift-prone, and ablation 3 (ledger row renamed → 12 pins red) covers exactly that. RIGHT.
- **Behaviour change (probe E).** Template: a token resolving to nothing handed `undefined`, so `seedDeclaredVariables` applied the child's `defaultValue`; envelope: the guarded form supplies `null`, which wins; a `script` function is handed `null` where it was handed `undefined`. Pinned through the shipped engine (§3 of the new pins: the `undefined` path, the `null` path, both ways to keep the default, per item on a `map`, the function case, and the refusal text). Named where an author sees it: the changeset body ("What changes for a value that may be absent", FROM→TO rows 1, 2 and 4), the D3 entry's `replacement` and `reason`, `flows.mdx`, the README, the schema `.describe()`, and the refusal itself. RIGHT.
- **Executors.** One resolver, `resolveValueSlotMap`: per key, shape dispatch by `isExpressionEnvelopeShaped` → `engine.evaluateValueEnvelope(value, variables, slot.key, context)`, every other value through `interpolate` as before; an envelope never reaches the interpolator and no `??` to it was added (the only `??` is the pre-existing `map ?? {}` of the CRUD resolver). `map` resolves once per item after the iterator and index bind; `subflow` and `script` in the parent's variables and run context. RIGHT.
- **`crud-nodes.ts`.** Base `resolveFieldValues`: `for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(fields ?? {})) out[key] = isExpressionEnvelopeShaped(value) ? engine.evaluateValueEnvelope(value, variables, 'fields.' + key, context) : interpolate(value, variables, context)`. Head: `resolveValueSlotMap(engine, fields, variables, 'fields', context)` — the same loop, same `?? {}`, same predicate, same evaluator call, same `fields.key` label, a literal (a list included) through `interpolate` as before. CRUD behaviour byte-identical. RIGHT.
- **Stored metadata (ADR-0087).** The window exemption covers the window, never the chain: one D3 semantic entry per retirement family; D2 only for a lossless mapping ("Semantic changes are excluded … goes to D3"). The step-18 entry `18.flow-value-slot-template-dialect-refused.ts` is amended: `surface` names the three maps; `replacement` and `reason` carry the callee-default consequence. No D2: the census's probe E measures that an absent value answers differently under the template (nothing → child default) and under CEL (a fault, or `null` under the guard) — not lossless, so D3 only. RIGHT. `registry.ts`: the hunk is the entry's text re-indented inside `step18.semantic` and nothing else moves — the generator's output, not a hand edit; `check:migration-registry --check` sits in `Lint & Repo Gates` (pending), and `Type Check · source gates` is green. Marker `not-required (already-registered flow-value-slot-template-dialect-refused)`: the id exists at the merge base and at the head, so the honest arm by the gate's own rule; `Check Changeset` green. RIGHT. Note, non-blocking: the entry's `acceptanceCriteria` still prescribes the bare `has(vars.x) ? vars.x : null` guard without the callee caveat — the `replacement` field two lines up carries the correction, so incomplete, not false; S2 amends the entry next and can fold it.
- **Out of surface.** The four crossings are mechanical: `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` (+3 `valueType` sites in the shape of the CRUD row `fields.valueType`; a hand-edited ledger by design that `build-schemas.ts` refuses without — header totals 223→226 / 701→704 match the body); `flow-text-slot-template.ts` (3 JSDoc lines on `FLOW_NODE_TEXT_SLOTS` that listed these three positions as keeping the single brace, made false by this diff); `crud-nodes.ts` (the generalisation the claim's own surface names — "a shared value-slot map resolver generalised from crud-nodes.ts"); the fixtures (map 8, script 3, subflow 2 token→envelope; one guard in `region-durable-suspension-refusal.test.ts` where the `parallel` parent binds no `row`). All 38 files map onto the claim's surface or a named crossing; none outside. `flows.mdx:1227` adds an `input` line to the map example that the base did not carry — an enrichment, coherent, not a crossing.
- **Lint.** No `packages/lint/src/*.ts` source line moves; the two hints flip by asking the judge, pinned in `lint-flow-patterns.test.ts`; no lint changeset entry owed. RIGHT.
- **Sites.** showcase 5 values / 3 nodes, todo 3 (each guarded; the function reads `null` as the empty value), docs 2 pages, README, dogfood 2 — match the census R1/R3 counts. `has(record.project.owner)` in showcase rests on the hydrated record (#7381) and on the showcase suite the dev reports green; not re-run here.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` major, `@objectstack/service-automation` major — the two published packages whose `src/**` moves (lint moved a test only; examples and `qa/dogfood` are private; docs are no package). RIGHT.
- Level: `.changeset/pre.json` on `main` is `{ mode: pre, tag: next }`; `check-changeset-no-major` stands aside in pre mode (its RC exemption) and its lockstep leg expects a pending `major` for spec; ADR-0087's "pre-GA ships `minor`" is the launch-window arm that the same guard's pre-mode arm supersedes for the v18 line. Passes 1–3 on `main` grade the same two packages `major`. Consistent; `Check Changeset` green on this head. RIGHT.
- Breaking carriers all present: `major`, the `**BREAKING**` banner, the `!` in the title, the `narrowing` arm; FROM→TO table and the one-line fix; the `null`-beats-default behaviour change is an author-visible sentence in the body. ADR-0087 marker present and accepted. RIGHT.
- Supersession: the pass-3 changeset on `main` (`19939-flow-value-slot-date-macros-refused.md:47`) still names a `subflow` input as keeping the single brace; nothing has shipped (`@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0, no `v18.*` tag), both compile into one `18.0.0-next.*` entry, and this changeset's "supersedes that line" sentence follows pass 3's own precedent. Acceptable.
- `Clause-②:` line: `no (narrowing)` in the PR body (line 2) and in the changeset — RIGHT, per ①.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev flags (`deviations`), each answered:
1. Four surface crossings — mechanical, accepted (①).
2. Callee sentence at the build doors only; executor parse without it — accepted; the boundary is pinned (①).
3. Ledger constants gain data; `LedgerDeclaredNodeType` widens — does not flip the line; `no (narrowing)` stands (①).
4. Assignee via a separate label-write stroke — process, not contract; no finding.
5. Trailer pair and footer form — AGENTS.md's form; no finding.
6. Two os-regen merges; header totals recomputed by hand — the baseline is hand-edited by design and body and header agree; right.
7. Background suite run, blocked on the PID — process; no finding.
8. Lock queue timeouts read as NOT MEASURED and repeated — process; no finding.
`open_questions`: empty — nothing to answer.

Out-of-scope carriers, each judged:
- S7 for the `lint-flow-patterns.ts` module comment (:669 lists `subflow.input` as single-brace; :661 still calls the date macros kept, stale since pass 3) — an internal comment and S7 deletes that arm: RIGHT.
- S3 for the `evaluateValueEnvelope` docblock — internal; S3 edits `engine.ts`: RIGHT.
- "承接者:无" for `predicateSlotRefusal` (`flow-node-expression-paths.ts:825`, names two of the six value-slot maps) — a refusal string an author reads, in a file this PR edits and whose docblock this PR itself updated to "Six maps". Incomplete, not false, so not a FAIL; but a carrier of none is WRONG: S7 (the stage plan's "canon fixes") at the latest, or a one-line patch here pointing the parenthetical at the ledger's `value` slots. The seat's call before enqueue.
- "承接者:无" for `examples/app-todo/src/functions/task.functions.ts:78` ("No flow node evaluates a value-producing expression") — false since #19938, and this PR's own `task.flow.ts` migration now hands that very function CEL-evaluated inputs. The file sits outside the claimed surface, so the dev was right to stop; a carrier of none is WRONG: S7 "the canon fixes" (ADR-0032 D4 — the canon is training data). Non-blocking; foldable into a patch round.
- S7 for the `validate-flow-template-paths` doubling — the note passes 1–3 carried: RIGHT.
- #22585 for `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md:268` ("inputs are interpolated") — Tier H, so not this PR's; #22585 is the open `domain:skills` card for #19939's skill drift, and the stage plan owes a pointer there at each landing: RIGHT, the seat posts the pointer at landing.
- The objectui companion card for `flow-node-config.ts:777` / `:1103` — the stage plan's own carrier, filed by the seat at ACCEPT: RIGHT, owed by the seat.
- The cross-repo ledger for hotcrm — NOT MEASURED, the plan's carrier: RIGHT.
- "the stage owners" for the five historical fixtures in `conversions/registry.ts` — D2 fixture pairs of graduated conversions at their own major's shape; the chain replays them and nothing parses them against the current contract; no sentence is false and nothing is owed: RIGHT (loosely named, no action).
